data.content_ref: inline:The target's 'mechanism' field is circular and self-referential. Instead of providing an independent explanatory account of why the Popperian preference holds, it restates the claim verbatim as its own justification: 'The reason this holds is that [the claim itself], which is what the mechanism above establishes.' This is bare assertion masquerading as mechanism — the field provides no causal or logical chain distinct from the claim it purports to support. Additionally, the text is garbled/truncated mid-sentence ('...to select th, which is what the mechanism above establishes'), indicating a copy or generation failure. A mechanism that merely restates the claim as the reason for the claim cannot ground the distinction between non-inductive methodological preference and induction; it leaves the central contention unsupported by any independent reasoning.
